nom: The INKEY List Salicylic Acid Acne + Blackhead Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced blackheads, controlled oiliness, and clearer pores with regular use.
segments.dry: Reviewers describing dry or perimenopausal skin generally say the cleanser does not strip or dry their skin, though a few restrict use to oilier zones like the nose and chin as a precaution.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer reports gradual disappearance of occasional acne with consistent use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and reactive skin reviewers mostly report no irritation, redness, or burning, with several on repeat bottles, though one notes a burning sensation for a second before settling.
segments.mature: Mature and perimenopausal reviewers use it selectively (mainly on nose/chin) to avoid dryness while still getting help with blackheads and enlarged pores.
segments.normal: One long-term reviewer with no specific skin type mentioned reports smooth, glowing skin after over a year of use.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer uses it only on select areas to avoid drying older skin while still targeting blackheads and pores.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it does not dry out or strip skin even with daily use; a couple note it can be somewhat drying and pair it with extra hydration afterward.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and calmer skin, including one who credits the green tint with visibly neutralizing redness, though one reviewer with rosacea says deep-seated rosacea spots are not helped.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers frequently describe the cleanser as gentle and non-stripping, avoiding flakiness or tightness even with regular or twice-daily use.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report spots and blemishes reducing in size, redness, or frequency, sometimes within days; two reviewers say it did nothing for their pimples/breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers note fewer, smaller, or faster-healing blemishes, including cystic and hormonal breakouts, though a couple of reviewers saw no improvement despite consistent use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin describe reduced excess oil and better pore appearance after regular use.

aspects.libelle: Effective as spot treatment beyond cleanser use
Product hard to dispense near end of bottle

extraits.titre: I have hormonal spots and PD- New fav in ance spot care
extraits.texte: Saw an ad for this and looked into it more. The ingredients looked good but I'm always nervous to try new stuff because I have sensitive and reactive skin, prone to dermatitis from random products. Let me just say, this has been amazing for me. I put it under my nose where I tend to get PD spots, on hormonal cyst acne they pops up, and any where needed, and have had no bad reactions. It does dry the acne area a little bit but that's to be expected with these ingredients and daily use. I used it on a big, under the skin cyst. It made the cyst slowly go down and its stay was shorter than it would have been. I also tried using it under makeup and it didn't make any skincare or makeup pill up. Highly recommend and will rebuy, and that will take a while because a little goes a long way.

I now have very dry, perimenopausal skin, so I only use this on my nose and chin. I keep it in the shower and a bottle lasts for ages as you don't need much. Good for my ever increasingly large pores on my chin and blackheads on my nose, and I realise it's a bit off book but if I do have the odd spot or new blackhead, I can just put a tiny dab on at night, and by the morning it's gone. Without upsetting my skin. What more can you ask?

extraits.titre: Effective without drying, stripping or making me itch 👌
extraits.texte: I love that I can use this daily to get oil, makeup 😉 and bacteria off of my skin, so it can breathe! I have super sensitive skin, mature, acne prone, oily skin and this product has dramatically decreased my breakouts, while keeping my skin soft and not overstripped. I adore my The INKEY List products and suggest them to people all the time!
I have combination skin and i suffered from acne from time to time however after consistently using the cleanser i noticed the acne disappearing gradually

Spots adieu!!! This is a super charged serum that really makes a difference to your spots. Unless, they are very deep-seated Rosaceae spots, unfortunately... Those I have not been able to treat yet. My husband also doesn't like the smell on my face, but thankfully I don't mind it.

I bought this from Inkey's website not ulta, and i can tell you the reviews there are not as high as they are here. Probably because *someone* decided to be shady and add reviews for the cleanser instead of the actual product hoping people wouldn't actually read the reviews. I gave this stuff about a month of using and it did literally nothing for my pimples. Gave it to my husband and didnt work for his either. Theres was better products out there for the same price. Dont waste your money
This is great for the oily areas around my nose. I try to keep it away from other areas, as I'm older and concerned it could be too drying. But the finish it leaves is refreshing and clean.
